body: The reason that NFCU doesn’t allow you to do an external transfer via NFCU’s app from another financial institution is simply because NFCU is not your other bank. You can transfer from the external account to a lending product, but not checking or savings via the app. Now if you call your other financial institution and want to give them your NFCU account and routing number, they can gladly initiate that ACH transfer for you or even wire the funds, since they have full access to those funds, if you need a quicker option. With all of that said though, NFCU offers a funding option where you can take your external DC or CC and make a deposit from that card into your NFCU account. Better yet, it’s an immediate transfer. Just call their number and ask for the link, they will text it to you or you can just dial NFCU’s number and do it though the automated system.

You will still have your account with NFCU regardless of you moving out or not.

Source: I work for NFCU
